name: adversarial-friends
description: Cross-examine artifacts with agent CLIs; Codex host self-review is advisory.

interface.shortDescription: Adversarial review with agent CLIs; Codex host review is advisory.
interface.longDescription: Adversarial Friends dispatches an artifact to agent CLIs and merges their critiques. In Codex, Codex remains the orchestrator and may contribute advisory host self-review; independent admission and judging authority come only from non-host friends.
